vision.name: Black Counter Blast
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If this card is revealed from your hand by a Mastery effect, you may draw a card. If you do, your opponent draws a card.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Your opponent can only attack or pass in their next action this combat.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Lower your opponent's anger 1.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: Endurance printed as a badge; transcribed as a leading 'ENDURANCE N.' line
